source: FamilySearch catalogue walk of the Croatian church-book collection, harvested in a browser by the Defranceski archive and imported here as a snapshot
licence: FamilySearch catalogue metadata (not an open licence)
why: FamilySearch's catalogue cannot be read by a script — every path answers 404 or a challenge to anything that is not a signed-in browser. This is the walk that was already done, not a repeat of it. Every other country needs the same walk, in a browser, and scripts/ingest-fs-catalogue.py in the Defranceski archive is the extractor that does it.
note: Volume-level detail: which book, for which years, and the link that opens its images. UNCHECKED — these are the catalogue's own titles and nobody here has opened a single one.
